title: The Glasshouse of the fourth floor walk-up
author: Noor Almeida
blurb: Bram Ravensworth, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
